meta.name: L A s Finest
meta.description:
Syd Burnett has left her complicated past behind to become an LAPD detective. Paired with a new partner, Nancy McKenna, a working mom with an equally complex past, Syd is pushed to examine whether her unapologetic lifestyle might be masking a greater personal secret. These two women don't agree on much, but they find common ground when it comes to taking on the most dangerous criminals in Los Angeles.

Complete series. On your server: S1 13/13 | S2 13/13

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: When a boy is targeted by a powerful cartel, two detectives with complex pasts race the clock to keep him safe, but when Syd's personal quest for justice threatens their efforts, the pair must decide whom they really serve and protect.

videos.title: Defiance
videos.overview: Tracking down a serial killer who lures his victims into isolated areas before killing them live on social media; Syd has a dangerous secret that clashes with McKenna's complicated past.

videos.title: Con Air
videos.overview: Syd and McKenna are called to investigate when a body seems to plummet from the sky; the partners realize they need to trust each other to escape the ghosts of their pasts.

videos.title: Déjà Vu
videos.overview: Time is up – Syd and McKenna need to get Knox’s fentanyl into police custody while leaving no trace of their own involvement. But can they pull it off when McKenna is distracted by Izzy’s strange behavior and a ghost from Syd’s past returns to haunt her?

videos.title: Farewell...
videos.overview: While fighting with their own complications, Syd and McKenna try and find the killer behind the death of a transgender woman. Syd must face her past as the hunt for Knox intensifies. McKenna helps Izzy deal with her grief.

videos.title: ...My Lovely
videos.overview: McKenna is unable to keep hiding the truth about her mother's accident from Syd.  Arlo plots against people Syd loves.  Syd and McKenna continue to hunt for the killer of the transgender woman and her fiancé.

videos.title: Book of Secrets
videos.overview: Syd and McKenna ramp up their personal search for Gabriel Knox and let the Bens in on their search for Arlo.  Syd faces a family crisis. McKenna must make a difficult choice.

videos.title: Dead Men Tell No Tales
videos.overview: McKenna is forced to come clean about her past to her husband, and both she and Syd attempt to convince him to bend the rule of law to save a life. In the meantime, our team find themselves trailing a group of thieves who managed to steal million of dollars' worth of untraceable diamonds.

videos.title: Dangerous Minds
videos.overview: It's busy for our team of detectives as they continue to investigate the case of the missing diamonds, and the task force executes a major drug bust. With the treat of Knox looming, both Syd and McKenna must confront some of their deepest secrets yet.

videos.title: Enemy of the State
videos.overview: As their pasts continue to crash into the present, Syd and McKenna discover that an unknown player has been manipulating them all along. Meanwhile, the search for the missing diamonds continues, just as McKenna is face with a impossible choice; her brother or her future.

videos.title: Thief
videos.overview: After a stunning discovery, Syd and McKenna debate who they can trust moving forward whilst also investigating a death that took place at a scenic Los Angeles park.

videos.title: Armageddon
videos.overview: As Syd and McKenna finally close in on Gabriel Knox, a shocking revelation makes their fight more personal than ever before.

videos.title: Bad Girls
videos.overview: Syd, McKenna and the team band together as they race against the clock to save one of their own, finally coming face-to-face with their greatest enemy.

videos.title: The Curse of the Black Pearl
videos.overview: With McKenna's help, Syd searches for Jen's killer as she grieves the loss of her friend. The death of a Koreatown legend has the community up in arms wondering who could be responsible.

videos.title: The Lone Ranger
videos.overview: As the team searches for the culprit behind the Koreatown crime surge, McKenna is triggered by memories from her experience in Iraq. Syd discovers a tape of Jen with an unexpected client.

videos.title: Thief of Hearts
videos.overview: After confronting one of Jen's old clients, Syd and McKenna think they are on the right track when their lives are threatened; on the Koreatown case, the team finally zeroes in on the criminal

videos.title: Beverly Hills Cops
videos.overview: With the Koreatown shooter behind bars, the team catches a new case involving a collegiate swimmer who is found dead in an apparent hit-and-run. Syd uncovers a new clue from Jen's past.

videos.title: Gone in 60 Seconds
videos.overview: After the team connects a new mobile app to a string of crimes, it learns that the Koreatown crime wave is far from over. Syd discovers a shocking truth about who Jen really was.

videos.title: Maverick
videos.overview: Amidst the chaos of investigating a case that overlaps with Nico's new hustle, McKenna starts family therapy, and Syd delivers bad news to Jen's family.

videos.title: March or Die
videos.overview: After sharing the truth about Jen's passing with her family, Syd receives some unexpected help on the case. McKenna and Patrick make a tough decision.

videos.title: Bad Company
videos.overview: The LAPD team races against the clock to rescue one of their own.

videos.title: Kangaroo Jack
videos.overview: Syd learns that the crime wave in Koreatown is forcing people out of their homes, drawing the attention of Ricky Leon. The LAPD searches for the team responsible for a deadly dispensary robbery.

videos.title: Deliver Us from Evil
videos.overview: When Emma goes missing, Syd will stop at nothing to bring her back home to her family. An undercover McKenna attends a veteran's retreat that could be sourcing the highly skilled Koreatown criminals.

videos.title: Rafferty and the Gold Dust Twins
videos.overview: Syd and Baines are threatened by an internal affairs investigation regarding Beverly Gamble's death; McKenna and Walker interrogate Duke Ingram which leads the team to an unexpected arms dealer.

videos.title: Coyote Ugly
videos.overview: As Patrick waits for the election results, the team works tirelessly to find Malcolm Ward, a killer at large. Syd offers to tell internal affairs the truth about what happened in the scrap yard.

videos.title: For Life
videos.overview: McKenna grieves the death of a loved one with Syd by her side. The LAPD detectives work as a united force to put an end to Lustrum Holdings and restore peace in Koreatown.
